info.brief: PCG Random Number Generator Native Extension for the Defold Game Engine
info.description: PCG Random Number Generator Native Extension for the Defold Game Engine

elements.name: rnd.new
elements.description: Creates an isolated RNG context and returns its context id. Call without arguments to seed from entropy, with init_state to use init_seq = 1, or with init_state and init_seq for exact unsigned 32-bit deterministic seeding.

parameters.name: init_state
parameters.doc: Optional starting state for the RNG. Must be an unsigned 32-bit integer.

parameters.name: init_seq
parameters.doc: Optional output sequence for the RNG. Must be an unsigned 32-bit integer.

elements.name: rnd.new64
elements.description: Creates an isolated RNG context using exact unsigned 64-bit decimal string seeds.

parameters.name: init_state
parameters.doc: Starting state for the RNG as an unsigned 64-bit decimal string.

parameters.name: init_seq
parameters.doc: Output sequence for the RNG as an unsigned 64-bit decimal string.

elements.name: rnd.reset
elements.description: Reseeds an existing RNG context. Call with only id to seed from entropy, with id and init_state to use init_seq = 1, or with id, init_state, and init_seq for exact unsigned 32-bit deterministic seeding.

parameters.name: init_state
parameters.doc: Optional starting state for the RNG. Must be an unsigned 32-bit integer.

parameters.name: init_seq
parameters.doc: Optional output sequence for the RNG. Must be an unsigned 32-bit integer.

elements.name: rnd.reset64
elements.description: Reseeds an existing RNG context using exact unsigned 64-bit decimal string seeds.

parameters.name: init_state
parameters.doc: Starting state for the RNG as an unsigned 64-bit decimal string.

parameters.name: init_seq
parameters.doc: Output sequence for the RNG as an unsigned 64-bit decimal string.

elements.name: rnd.delete
elements.description: Deletes an RNG context. The context id becomes invalid.

elements.name: rnd.clear_contexts
elements.description: Deletes all RNG contexts. Existing context ids become invalid.

elements.name: rnd.state
elements.description: Returns raw PCG state and increment as unsigned 64-bit decimal strings.

returnvalues.name: Increment
returnvalues.doc: Raw PCG increment. Controls the PCG stream.

elements.name: rnd.set_state
elements.description: Restores raw PCG state and increment from unsigned 64-bit decimal strings.

parameters.name: increment
parameters.doc: Raw PCG increment. Controls the PCG stream.

elements.name: rnd.number
elements.description: Returns a 32-bit unsigned integer.

elements.name: rnd.numbers
elements.description: Returns a table of 32-bit unsigned integers.

parameters.name: count
parameters.doc: Number of values to generate. Must be a non-negative integer.

elements.name: rnd.bound
elements.description: Returns a 32-bit unsigned integer in [0, upper_bound).

parameters.name: upper_bound
parameters.doc: Exclusive upper bound. Must be an unsigned 32-bit integer greater than 0.

returnvalues.name: Random Number
returnvalues.doc: Returns a 32-bit unsigned integer in [0, upper_bound).

elements.name: rnd.range
elements.description: Returns a 32-bit unsigned integer between min and max values, inclusive. Only unsigned integers are supported.

returnvalues.name: Random Number
returnvalues.doc: Returns a 32-bit unsigned integer between min and max values.

elements.name: rnd.ranges
elements.description: Returns a table of 32-bit unsigned integers between min and max values, inclusive.

parameters.name: count
parameters.doc: Number of values to generate. Must be a non-negative integer.

returnvalues.name: Random Numbers
returnvalues.doc: Table of 32-bit unsigned integers between min and max values.

elements.name: rnd.double
elements.description: Returns a floating point number in [0, 1).

returnvalues.name: Random Number
returnvalues.doc: Returns a floating point number in [0, 1).

elements.name: rnd.doubles
elements.description: Returns a table of floating point numbers in [0, 1).

parameters.name: count
parameters.doc: Number of values to generate. Must be a non-negative integer.

returnvalues.name: Random Numbers
returnvalues.doc: Table of floating point numbers in [0, 1).

elements.name: rnd.double_range
elements.description: Returns a floating point number in [min, max). Not fast as rnd.double(id)

returnvalues.name: Random Number
returnvalues.doc: Returns a floating point number in [min, max).

elements.name: rnd.boolean
elements.description: Returns true or false with equal probability.

elements.name: rnd.chance
elements.description: Returns true according to the given probability.

parameters.name: probability
parameters.doc: Probability from 0.0 to 1.0. Values <= 0 are always false and values >= 1 are always true.

returnvalues.name: Success
returnvalues.doc: True if the probability check succeeds.

elements.name: rnd.toss
elements.description: Toss a coin.

elements.name: rnd.roll
elements.description: Roll the dice.

elements.name: rnd.card
elements.description: Picks a standard deck card index.

elements.name: rnd.card2
elements.description: Picks a standard deck suit and rank.

elements.name: rnd.dice
elements.description: Rolls dice using one of the exported dice constants.

parameters.name: roll
parameters.doc: Roll count. Must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: type
parameters.doc: Dice type. Use rnd.d4, rnd.d6, rnd.d8, rnd.d10, rnd.d12, rnd.d20, or rnd.d100.

elements.name: rnd.shuffle
elements.description: Shuffles the array part of a table in place using Fisher-Yates.

returnvalues.name: Array
returnvalues.doc: The same table, shuffled in place.

elements.name: rnd.check
elements.description: Debug/sample method that prints PCG sample output and consumes RNG state.
